name: The Journey
description: God guides step by step. Look back at what He has done, trust Him with what is next, and commit to the habits that will keep you walking together.

cards.title: Trust in the LORD
cards.prompt: Where do you most need to trust God with the whole map right now?
cards.body: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding. In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.

cards.title: Press Forward
cards.prompt: Name one thing behind you that you're ready to leave and one thing ahead you're reaching for.
cards.body: Brethren, I count not myself to have apprehended: but this one thing I do, forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those things which are before, I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.

cards.title: A Lamp for My Feet
cards.prompt: If God's Word is a lamp, what step is it lighting up for you today?
cards.body: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.

cards.title: Commit Your Way
cards.prompt: Share one plan or dream you want to commit to God.
cards.body: Commit thy way unto the LORD; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.

cards.title: He Will Guide
cards.prompt: Explain this verse to the group using only 5 words.
cards.body: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will guide thee with mine eye.

cards.prompt: What's the best trip or journey you've ever taken?
If your life were a road, what would you name the road you're on now?
What's something God led you into that you didn't see coming?
Which habit do you most want to grow: Word, prayer, serving, or gratitude? Why?
What area of your life is hardest to trust God with?
Looking back over this journey, what has God taught you most?

cards.title: Draw Your Road
cards.prompt: Draw your faith journey in 60 seconds with hills, valleys, and signposts, then explain one part.

cards.title: Map Partner
cards.prompt: Choose someone in the group to pray with once this week and agree on a time.

cards.title: Verse Pocket
cards.prompt: Write today's verse on a card and put it where you'll see it every day.

cards.title: One Habit
cards.prompt: Say one spiritual habit you'll keep going out loud, with the day you'll start.

cards.title: Pray Forward
cards.prompt: Pray one sentence thanking God for the past and one asking for guidance tomorrow.

cards.title: Journey Map
cards.prompt: Draw a road with hills and signposts for a Bible journey (Abraham, Moses, Paul) and let the other team guess whose it is.
cards.instruction: One drawer per team. No letters or words. First correct guess scores.

cards.title: Bible Road Trip
cards.prompt: Put these in order, fastest team wins: Creation, Noah, Abraham, Moses, David, Jesus' birth, the Resurrection, Pentecost.
cards.instruction: Write the order on paper and show it to the group when finished.

cards.title: Verse Memory Sprint
cards.prompt: Memorize Proverbs 3:5-6 and recite it together without looking.
cards.instruction: The whole team must say it together to score.

cards.title: Landmark Quiz
cards.prompt: Name places in the Bible: Bethlehem, the Jordan River, Jericho, Galilee, Nazareth, and more.
Share a time God redirected your plans for the better.
Tell about a time you needed direction and found it.
Share a small step of faith that became a big change.
Tell about one thing God taught you over these four weeks.
